name: Big Sur South Block 08 original 2 m bathymetry and derived terrain class

producer.name: CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab

units.derived_terrain_roughness_class: original categorical code; rough/smooth and depth band

temporal.update_cadence: Static 2011 acquisition; monthly original-archive integrity and source-catalog review.

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI archive of the original CSUMB survey; not an independent seabed measurement
transformations: Opened the exact hash-pinned Esri bathymetry and terrain grids; counted valid cells and transformed the valid-cell bounding envelope to WGS84; no cell interpolation, vertical-datum conversion, target polygon or waypoint generated.

evidence.supports: NOAA original survey page identifies BSS_Block12 and links the product archive.
Original producer metadata identifies the bathymetry product, acquisition period and unresolved access/use constraints.
Producer's current policy restricts for-profit use without express permission, despite NOAA's general archive availability statement.

limitations: The original 1,560,971 valid cells have a bounded envelope, but that rectangle contains gaps and cannot be used as a fishing area.
Of those cells, 967,275 have source NAVD88 elevations nominally within 200 ft and 155,135 share a derived rough class; neither count is chart-datum-qualified or independently confirmed hard bottom.
Rough/smooth codes are derived from the same depth surface, not independent rock or fish observations.
NOAA's general public-access language and the producer's for-profit restriction have not been reconciled for public commercial reuse of these derived products.
No MPA, local-rule, hazard, route or species assessment has qualified a fishing target or export.
